source.note: LIVE SAMPLE, not a fixture. A snapshot of api.get_sublog output, for looking at the picture. Nothing asserts against it; re-pull rather than edit it.

data_honesty.truncation: GH Archive caps PushEvent.commits at 20; events with attrs.truncated = true describe a push with more commits than are drawn.
data_honesty.commit_time: first-seen in PushEvent, NOT real git commit time
data_honesty.extracted_edges: Links we parsed from text or timing (closing keywords and references in PR bodies and titles, branch-ref matches, commit-message references, timing proximity) render dashed.
data_honesty.validated_edges: Links the platform's own data asserts (an exact SHA match, GitHub's own closed-via-commit record) render solid.
data_honesty.derived_openings: An IssueOpened or PullRequestOpened with attrs.source = 'payload' was never recorded as an event: its time and actor are read from a later event's payload (attrs.derived_from). It names no actor when the account has no actor record; attrs.opened_by then names it.
data_honesty.commit_authorship: vmap.commit_author_name is a git identity string and is NOT joined to any GitHub account. The actor a Push event names (its pusher relationship) is the PUSHER.

vmap.title: Notebook cell execution model
vmap.body_excerpt:
Somewhat a continuation of https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/103713

Today, execution results are parts metadata and output and execution itself is done via kernels which come from kernel providers. We should try to model execution results into a single entity, e.g execution status (idle, running, scheduled? etc)
